01-email-basics.md.description: Module 07 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 1 --- Email (Electronic Mail) is a method of sending and receiving messages over the internet using electronic devices like computers, smartphones, and tablets. It is one of the oldest and most widely used internet services. Think of email as a digital version of a physical letter. 03-mailbox-management.md.title: Mailbox Management
03-mailbox-management.md.description: Module 07 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 3 --- Every email account has a set of standard folders that help organize your messages. Think of these folders like different trays on a desk — each tray holds a different type of mail. CCC Exam Tip: "Emails that have been composed but not yet sent are stored in ___" — Answer: Drafts folder. "Deleted emails are moved to ___" — Answer: Trash/Bin folder. 04-email-protocols.md.title: Email Protocols
04-email-protocols.md.description: Module 07 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 4 --- A protocol is a set of rules that computers follow to communicate with each other. Email protocols are the rules that govern how emails are sent, received, and stored on the internet. Think of protocols like traffic rules — just as vehicles follow traffic rules to move safely on roads, computers follow protocols to exchange emails correctly. 05-netiquette-messaging.md.title: Netiquette and Instant Messaging
05-netiquette-messaging.md.description: Module 07 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 5 --- Netiquette is short for Network Etiquette (or Internet Etiquette). It refers to the set of informal rules and guidelines for polite and respectful behavior when communicating on the internet. Just as there are manners for face-to-face conversations (like saying "please" and "thank you"), there are manners for online communication.
